name: changelog
description: Reusable changelog collection, generation, publishing, CLI, API, SDK, and MCP server for Hasna-coded apps.

notes: bins_match_package and surface_matrix (api/mcp) remain open: the current kit forbids a library repo from declaring -serve/-mcp bins (schemas.ts RepoClassSchema), and surface bins must be declared in bins, so changelog-mcp and changelog-serve cannot be declared while class is library. Reclassifying to cli-with-store would require asserting sqlite+postgresql engines, a pgTestGate, an OpenAPI document and a generated SDK that the JSONL-file store does not implement — the same honest refusal documented in apps/feedback/docs/contract-conformance.md.
